fields.name: population
fields.label: Population
fields.description: Population with its scope and year, e.g. "17,588 in the Grandpass South division (2012 census)". Shown as the first line of the Overview list.

fields.name: district
fields.label: District
fields.description: e.g. "Colombo District". Shown as a quick-facts chip.

fields.name: approxLocation
fields.label: Approx Location
fields.description: One short line on where the area is, e.g. "About 9 km from Colombo Fort by road". Quick-facts chip.

fields.name: nearbyAreas
fields.label: Nearby Areas
fields.description: Neighbouring areas, nearest first (4-6). A name that matches another neighborhood page links to it. Feeds the "Nearby major areas" chip and the "Explore nearby areas" links.

fields.name: latitude
fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: Centre of the area map.

fields.name: longitude
fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: Centre of the area map.

fields.name: mapRadiusKm
fields.label: Map Radius Km
fields.description: Radius (km) of the "approximate area" circle drawn on the map, usually 1-3.

fields.name: description
fields.label: About the neighbourhood
fields.description: 300-600 words, paragraphs separated by a blank line: where it is, what it is known for, connectivity, lifestyle, development activity, who looks for property there. No prices, no property-portal names.

fields.name: sources
fields.label: Sources
fields.description: Where the facts above came from. Printed as "Source: …" under the overview. Official and reference pages only, never property portals.

fields.name: faqs
fields.label: FAQs (authored)
fields.description: Two authored answers: what the area is known for, and whether it is close to Colombo. The questions about new homes and projects are generated on the page from the live listings.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero Image
fields.description: Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: heroImageCredit
fields.label: Hero Image Credit
fields.description: Photographer credit for the hero photo, e.g. "Photo: Zoshua Colah / Unsplash". Required for Creative Commons photos; shown under the photo gallery.

fields.name: heroImageSourceUrl
fields.label: Hero Image Source Url
fields.description: Link to the original hero photo page (the credit links here).

fields.name: highlights
fields.label: Key Highlights
fields.description: 3-5 short standout facts shown at the top of the neighborhood page (e.g. "16 km from central Colombo").

fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Photo Gallery
fields.description: More photos of the area — famous landmarks (a well-known school, park, mall, temple, beach) work best. Sharp, at least 2400px wide, never a listing render. The hero image above stays the page banner.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Url
fields.description: Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: What the photo shows, e.g. "Mount Lavinia Hotel".

fields.name: credit
fields.label: Credit
fields.description: Photographer credit, e.g. "Photo: Zoshua Colah / Unsplash". Required for Creative Commons photos.

fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.label: Source Url
fields.description: Link to the original photo page (the credit links here).

fields.name: landmark
fields.label: Landmark
fields.description: Optional. Name of the Known Landmark this photo shows — it must match a Nearby place name exactly. Photos with a landmark appear in the Known Landmarks section; the others appear in the Photos section.

fields.name: lat
fields.label: Lat
fields.description: Optional. Latitude — puts the place on the area map.

fields.name: lng
fields.label: Lng
fields.description: Optional. Longitude — puts the place on the area map.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Search engine & sharing
fields.description: What Google and social apps show for this page. Everything is optional — blank fields fall back to the page name and text.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: SEO title
fields.description: The blue headline in Google. Aim for about 60 characters or fewer. Blank = the page name.

fields.name: seoDescription
fields.label: SEO description
fields.description: The grey text under it. Aim for 120–160 characters.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Share image
fields.description: Picture shown when the page is shared. Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: canonicalUrl
fields.label: Canonical URL
fields.description: Only if this page should count as a copy of another address. Usually leave blank.

fields.name: noIndex
fields.label: Hide this page from search engines
